name: When is the best time of year to start a major home renovation project?

mainEntity.name: When is the best time of year to start a major home renovation project?

acceptedAnswer.text: While indoor renovations can happen any time, spring and fall are often preferred for major projects due to milder weather, which is ideal for exterior work, deliveries, and maintaining comfortable indoor conditions during construction. Summer can be busy for contractors and suppliers, while winter might pose challenges with rain or colder temperatures, especially for exterior projects. However, the 'best' time ultimately depends on your project's specific needs, contractor availability, and your personal schedule.
acceptedAnswer.description: Spring and fall are generally best for major renovations due to milder weather, aiding exterior work and deliveries.
